If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
It depends on whether the order can be stopped before it is processed.
If your cancellation is successful before the order is processed: we will issue the refund once the cancellation is confirmed, and it will appear in your account within 5 working days from the date it is processed.
If the order has already been processed or shipped: please let it arrive and return it. Returned parcels can take up to 14 days to reach us from the date you send them back. We will email you when your return is completed, and your refund will then appear in your account within 5 working days from the date it is processed.
If you would like me to check whether cancellation is still possible for your order, let me know and I will take care of the next steps.
